int main(){ unsigned char src[]={0x30,0x05,0x00,0x00,0x80,0x80,0x80}; size_t len=sizeof(src); unsigned char *p=malloc(len); memcpy(p,src,len); struct mg_mqtt_message mm; int r=mg_mqtt_parse(p,len,5,&mm); printf("r=%d\n", r); free(p); }
